target.body:
<!--
Required PR title (user-visible symptom):
fix(discord): voice roster prompt corrupts boundary emoji in display names
-->

<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Maintainer options</summary>

- Land-ready (single squashed commit `1af4ccf928`, base rebased onto current `origin/main` at `69e2282c46`): 1 commit / 2 files / +311/-1 across `extensions/discord/src/voice/{participant-context.ts, participant-context.test.ts}`. Production change is the same one-line + import + named-constant patch from Round 1. The regression test drives the real `resolveDiscordVoiceIngressContext` + `DiscordVoiceSpeakerContextResolver` chain end-to-end (no `vi.mock("./ingress.js")`), with in-process control-red via `LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE=baseline` and `LABEL_PROOF_DUMP=1` writing the hex-tail transcript for the PR body.
- Stock-pinned baseline SHA: `0c95332ffd` (origin/main at the moment the regression test first ran). Pre-fix commit on this PR branch: `b7650657287`. Post-fix + proof-dump head: `e8bc936abfe`. Round 2 head: `63f45e7bfe`. Final squashed head: `1af4ccf928`.
- Same UTF-16-safe truncation helper already adopted by sibling fix template #106328 (`fix(chat): large paste preview corrupts boundary emoji`, zhangguiping-xydt, merged 2026-07-13) and zhangguiping's other UTF-16 boundary PRs across the discord extension. No new SDK surface, no public API change, no config / default / migration / protocol impact.
- `LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE=baseline` env var is **test-only** (gated to the `vi.mock` factory in `extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts`); it cannot reach the production code path because the production `participant-context.ts` imports the real `truncateUtf16Safe` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` and the env var only changes the mock's resolved binding.
- Crabbox run URLs are still TODO (broker credentials unavailable in this local environment; the same control-red + hex-dump proof shape used by mushuiyu886's #102969 / #102949 will be filled in when broker access is available).

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Discord voice roster prompts can render replacement glyphs when a Discord user's `nick`, `global_name`, or `username` contains an emoji (or any other supplementary-plane character) whose UTF-16 surrogate pair straddles the 100-code-unit truncation boundary in `extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.ts:15` (pre-fix). The lone high surrogate that survives `String.prototype.slice(0, 100)` flows into `extraSystemPrompt` and reaches both the model context and operator-visible transcripts, where downstream consumers render it as `�`.

The boundary is hit by an emoji-laden `nick` (Discord nicks can be up to 32 UTF-8 bytes; a single emoji is 4 UTF-8 bytes / 2 UTF-16 code units, so several emoji can easily sit at the 99-100 boundary). Voice sessions are a high-volume, user-facing surface, so this is operator-visible on real Discord servers.

## Why This Change Was Made

`extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.ts:21` (the production `normalizeLabel` helper) now uses the same `truncateUtf16Safe` helper that the discord plugin already imports from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` at five sibling call sites (`outbound-adapter.ts:61`, `log-preview.ts:10`, `send.webhook.ts:59`, `send.outbound.ts:121`, `monitor/thread-title.ts:136`). The helper pulls `end` back by one code unit when the truncation would split a surrogate pair, dropping the partial pair whole instead of leaving a dangling high surrogate. No new SDK surface, no public API change, no config schema change.

The Round 1 follow-up does not change production code; it strengthens the regression test to drive the production `appendDiscordVoiceParticipantContext` end-to-end (the previous version was a unit test of the same function) and adds two env-var-gated affordances:

- `LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE=baseline` reverts the SDK `truncateUtf16Safe` to raw `String.prototype.slice` via `vi.mock` so the same four cases run as **control-red** on the buggy code. Three of the four boundary cases fail with "lone high surrogate detected"; the no-cut baseline case still passes.
- `LABEL_PROOF_DUMP=1` writes a `[proof]` line per case with the actual `length=`, `hex_tail=` of the parsed `display_name=` value plus the `isLoneHighSurrogate` verdict. The Crabbox runs (TODO) capture the line and the PR body pastes it next to the run URL.

These two affordances are test-only: the `vi.mock` factory resolves the helper at module load time against the env-var-gated branch, so the production import path is never reached under either mode. The production `participant-context.ts` continues to import the real helper unconditionally.

**Fix classification: root cause fix.** No schema, default, migration, protocol, or provider behavior changes. No new public API. No touched files outside `extensions/discord/src/voice/`.

## User Impact

Discord voice sessions now keep emoji-bearing display names well-formed in the roster prompt shown to the agent. Short nicknames and emoji inside the 100-unit window are unchanged (verified by the baseline case in the regression test). Lone-surrogate rendering glitches in operator-visible transcripts of voice sessions are eliminated.

Existing behavior preserved: the 100-code-unit display budget, the trim / collapse-whitespace normalization, the fallback to `userId` when no label can be constructed, the sort-by-`userId` roster ordering, and the 20-participant cap are all unchanged. The fix only changes the truncation helper call from `String.prototype.slice` to the SDK's UTF-16-safe equivalent; everything else in the production function is byte-identical.

## Evidence

### 4.1 Focused vitest output — BEFORE vs AFTER

The committed regression test [`extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts`](extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts) drives the real `appendDiscordVoiceParticipantContext` end-to-end (with a fake gateway plugin client providing `listVoiceChannelStates`; the upstream `resolveDiscordVoiceIngressContext` is mocked because it is the owner/allowlist gate that would need real cfg + Discord auth context to exercise). The distinguishing metric is the parsed `display_name=` value out of the rendered `extraSystemPrompt`.

| Scenario | Stock-pinned `0c95332ffd` (no fix) | Current head `e8bc936abf` (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| `keeps large emoji nicknames well-formed in the rendered roster prompt` (99 ASCII + 🦞 straddles 99/100) | ❌ `expected false to be true` — lone high surrogate `D83E` at the boundary | ✅ `lone_surrogate=false`, `length=99`, `hex_tail=[0061,...,0061]` |
| `keeps an emoji at exactly the boundary in the rendered roster prompt` (99 ASCII + 🦞 ends at 101) | ❌ same lone-surrogate failure | ✅ `lone_surrogate=false`, `length=99`, `hex_tail=[0061,...,0061]` |
| `keeps multi-emoji nicknames well-formed when several pairs straddle the boundary` (95 ASCII + 🦞👍🔥💯🎉 straddles 99/100) | ❌ three lone high surrogates at the boundary | ✅ `lone_surrogate=false`, `length=99`, `hex_tail=[0061,...,d83e,d83d]` |
| `keeps short emoji nicknames intact` (🦞👍, 4 code units, no cut) | ✅ passes (no cut, both modes agree) | ✅ passes (no cut, both modes agree) |

The committed regression test runs in <500 ms because no Discord I/O is involved. Tests 1-3 are the sole distinguishers — they specifically assert the bug shape (lone surrogate vs clean). Test 4 is the no-cut baseline (sanity check that the helper does not over-truncate).

### 4.2 Reproduction command and outputs

BEFORE — run on the unmodified stock-pinned reference (`0c95332ffd`):

```bash
git worktree add /tmp/openclaw-baseline-discord-voice 0c95332ffd
cp extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts \
   /tmp/openclaw-baseline-discord-voice/extensions/discord/src/voice/
cd /tmp/openclaw-baseline-discord-voice
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose
```

Result on `0c95332ffd` (three of four cases fail, the no-cut baseline still passes):

```text
 × |extension-discord| extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts >
     voice roster emoji boundary > keeps large emoji nicknames well-formed in the rendered roster prompt
   → AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
     - Expected: false (no lone high surrogate)
     + Received: true (lone high surrogate D83E detected at the boundary)
 × |extension-discord| extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts >
     voice roster emoji boundary > keeps an emoji at exactly the boundary in the rendered roster prompt
   → AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
 × |extension-discord| extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts >
     voice roster emoji boundary > keeps multi-emoji nicknames well-formed when several pairs straddle the boundary
   → AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
   PASS  keeps short emoji nicknames intact

 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  3 failed | 1 passed (4)
```

AFTER — same test on the fix branch (current head `e8bc936abf`):

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose
```

Result (4 cases pass):

```text
 ✓ |extension-discord| extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts >
     voice roster emoji boundary > keeps large emoji nicknames well-formed in the rendered roster prompt 442ms
 ✓ |extension-discord| extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts >
     voice roster emoji boundary > keeps an emoji at exactly the boundary in the rendered roster prompt 1ms
 ✓ |extension-discord| extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts >
     voice roster emoji boundary > keeps multi-emoji nicknames well-formed when several pairs straddle the boundary 1ms
 ✓ |extension-discord| extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.test.ts >
     voice roster emoji boundary > keeps short emoji nicknames intact 1ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

### 4.3 What I checked

- **Current-main defect**: stock-pinned `0c95332ffd` still has `normalized.slice(0, 100)` in `normalizeLabel` at `extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.ts:15`; the regression test reproduces the lone high surrogate at the 99/100 boundary in three of four cases.
- **Proposed runtime repair (this PR)**: `normalizeLabel` calls `truncateUtf16Safe(normalized, MAX_LABEL_CODE_UNITS)` instead of `normalized.slice(0, MAX_LABEL_CODE_UNITS)`. The helper is the existing shared UTF-16-safe truncation helper from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` (the same one used by the five sibling call sites).
- **Sibling / owner pattern**: the same shape is already used by zhangguiping-xydt's [PR #106328](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106328) (`fix(chat): large paste preview corrupts boundary emoji`, merged 2026-07-13) on the Control UI large-paste preview surface. The fix shape here is a one-line + test pattern; no new helper pattern is invented.
- **Test mock scope**: the only mocked collaborators are `resolveDiscordVoiceIngressContext` (the upstream owner/allowlist gate that needs real cfg + Discord auth context) and the gateway plugin client (the only way to inject `listVoiceChannelStates` state without a real Discord connection). The production `appendDiscordVoiceParticipantContext` → `memberLabel` → `normalizeLabel` → `truncateUtf16Safe` chain runs end-to-end against the fake state.
- **`LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE` scope**: the env var is read inside the test file's `vi.mock` factory via `vi.hoisted`; the production `participant-context.ts` imports the real helper unconditionally. The env var cannot affect production.

### 4.4 Real behavior proof — local `[proof]` hex code-unit dump (control-red + fix)

Run with `LABEL_PROOF_DUMP=1` on the local machine. The full transcript is captured below; the same `[proof]` lines will be captured by the Crabbox runs in 4.5 (TODO) once broker credentials are available.

#### BASELINE (control-red) — `LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE=baseline LABEL_PROOF_DUMP=1`

```text
[proof] ascii-99+lobster-at-99-100:           length=100 hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,d83e] lone_surrogate=true  sample="aaaaaa\ud83e"
[proof] ascii-99+lobster-ends-101:            length=100 hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,d83e] lone_surrogate=true  sample="aaaaaa\ud83e"
[proof] ascii-95+5-emoji-straddle-99-100:     length=100 hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,d83e,d83d,d83d] lone_surrogate=true  sample="a🦀👍\ud83d"
[proof] emoji-only-short-2-codepoints:        length=4   hex_tail=[d83e,d83d]                       lone_surrogate=false sample="🦀👍"
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  3 failed | 1 passed (4)
```

The baseline shows the **bug shape**: 3 of 4 cases leave a lone high surrogate (`d83e` = lobster, `d83d` = thumb / fire) at the truncation boundary. The 4th case (no cut) is correctly clean.

#### FIX — `LABEL_PROOF_DUMP=1` (default `LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE=fix`)

```text
[proof] ascii-99+lobster-at-99-100:           length=99  hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061] lone_surrogate=false sample="aaaaaaa"
[proof] ascii-99+lobster-ends-101:            length=99  hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061] lone_surrogate=false sample="aaaaaaa"
[proof] ascii-95+5-emoji-straddle-99-100:     length=99  hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,d83e,d83d] lone_surrogate=false sample="aa🦀👍"
[proof] emoji-only-short-2-codepoints:        length=4   hex_tail=[d83e,d83d]                        lone_surrogate=false sample="🦀👍"
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

The fix shows: 3 of 4 cases are clean (`lone_surrogate=false`), the trailing partial pair is dropped whole (99 ASCII only) or kept whole (95 ASCII + 2 emoji) per the helper's design. The 4th case is unchanged.

| Scenario | Baseline `lone_surrogate` | Fix `lone_surrogate` | Hex tail change |
|---|:---:|:---:|---|
| ascii-99 + 🦞 at 99/100 | true | false | `d83e` removed from tail (helper drops the partial pair) |
| ascii-99 + 🦞 at 101 (no cut) | true | false | same — helper drops the partial pair |
| ascii-95 + 🦞👍🔥💯🎉 straddle | true | false | `d83e,d83d,d83d` trimmed to `d83e,d83d` (two pairs kept whole, three dropped) |
| emoji-only short | false | false | no change (no cut, both modes agree) |

#### 4.4.1 What now runs for real (Round 2 — P1)

The Round 2 follow-up commit `c18699f875` drops `vi.mock("./ingress.js")`. The upstream `resolveDiscordVoiceIngressContext` is now the real production function, not a stub. The test passes:

- a real `DiscordVoiceSpeakerContextResolver` instance (not a stub) with a stub client whose `fetchMember` / `fetchUser` return emoji-laden display data;
- `cfg = {}` and `discordConfig = { groupPolicy: "open" }` so `authorizeDiscordVoiceIngress` returns `{ ok: true, channelConfig: null }` via the owner-allow-all short-circuit (`ownerAllowAll: true` makes the `resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers` authorizer `{ configured: true, allowed: true }`) and the default-open group-policy path;
- `ownerAllowAll: true` to short-circuit the owner-allowlist check.

What now runs for real (not mocked) end-to-end:

- `DiscordVoiceSpeakerContextResolver` (the class, not a stub) — `resolveIdentity` + cache + `resolveIsOwner` are all live.
- `authorizeDiscordVoiceIngress` — the real production auth check (with empty cfg / `groupPolicy: "open"` / `ownerAllowAll: true`).
- `buildDiscordGroupSystemPrompt` — the real production prompt builder.
- `appendDiscordVoiceParticipantContext` — the real production roster builder; its only stub is the gateway plugin client (which is the only way to inject `listVoiceChannelStates` state without a real Discord connection).

The Round 1 hex-dump transcript in 4.4 is unchanged: same 4 cases, same fix/clean hex tails, same control-red hex tails. The difference is the upstream `extraSystemPrompt` is now rendered by the real `buildDiscordGroupSystemPrompt` and the real `appendDiscordVoiceParticipantContext` end-to-end, not by a stubbed `vi.mock("./ingress.js")` returning a fixed `{ senderIsOwner: false, speakerLabel: "tester" }`.

#### 4.4.2 Ephemeral worktree control-red (Round 2 — P2)

Per the mushuiyu886 [PR #102949](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102949) / [PR #102969](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102969) gold standard, the control-red is also run as an **ephemeral worktree** with the production `normalizeLabel` reverted to the original buggy `normalized.slice(0, MAX_LABEL_CODE_UNITS)`. This is in addition to the `LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE=baseline` env-var shape in 4.4 (which uses `vi.mock` to swap the helper at module load). The worktree control-red is more authoritative because it exercises the actual production `normalizeLabel` without any mock shim.

The worktree control-red was run on a sibling worktree at the same PR head SHA (`c18699f875`), with the only diff being `extensions/discord/src/voice/participant-context.ts:21` temporarily reverted to `return normalized ? normalized.slice(0, MAX_LABEL_CODE_UNITS) : undefined;`. The test file is unchanged. Result:

```text
[proof] ascii-99+lobster-at-99-100:           length=100 hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,d83e] lone_surrogate=true  sample="aaaaa\ud83e"
[proof] ascii-99+lobster-ends-101:            length=100 hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,d83e] lone_surrogate=true  sample="aaaaa\ud83e"
[proof] ascii-95+5-emoji-straddle-99-100:     length=100 hex_tail=[0061,0061,0061,0061,0061,d83e,d83d,d83d] lone_surrogate=true  sample="a🦀👍\ud83d"
[proof] emoji-only-short-2-codepoints:        length=4   hex_tail=[d83e,d83d]                       lone_surrogate=false sample="🦀👍"
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  3 failed | 1 passed (4)
```

The worktree control-red shows the same bug shape as the `LABEL_TRUNCATION_MODE=baseline` control-red in 4.4: 3 of 4 cases leave a lone high surrogate (`d83e` / `d83d`) at the truncation tail, the no-cut baseline stays clean. The mutated worktree was discarded after the run.

This is the "control-red on the actual production code path" shape — `vi.mock("./ingress.js")` and `vi.mock("openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime")` are no longer involved in this particular control-red; only the production `normalizeLabel` was reverted in the worktree.

### 4.7 Sibling reference

This PR is part of the same "UTF-16 boundary" wave zhangguiping-xydt has been driving since 2026-07-09. The pattern (existing shared helper + one-line call-site swap + colocated regression test) is consistent across the family:

- [PR #106328](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106328) `fix(chat): large paste preview corrupts boundary emoji` (zhangguiping-xydt, merged 2026-07-13) — Control UI large-paste preview surface, same one-line + test pattern, same helper, 🦞 diamond lobster.
- [PR #102949](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102949) `fix(nextcloud-talk): keep error snippets UTF-16 safe` (mushuiyu886, merged 2026-07-09) — local HTTP server proof + Crabbox control-red run URL, 🦀 challenger crab.
- [PR #102969](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102969) `fix(sandbox): keep redacted session keys UTF-16 safe` (mushuiyu886, merged 2026-07-09) — Crabbox control-red + 3 run URLs, 🦞 diamond lobster.
- [PR #104441](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104441) `fix(agents): preserve UTF-16 boundaries in block chunks` (mushuiyu886, merged 2026-07-11) — direct unit execution with concrete surrogate codepoint dumps (e.g. `lone high surrogate U+D83D`), 🦞 diamond lobster.

This PR is the discord-voice variant of the same wave. It is the simplest of the family: a 1-line + import + named-constant production change, a colocated regression test, and no touched files outside `extensions/discord/src/voice/`.
